what: Each synthetic backtest trade must include a fee equal to 0.0005 * qty * price, within an absolute tolerance of 0.01.
why: Correct the omission of fees from the synthetic fee-free ledger.
scope: Synthetic backtest trades in quant-desk; checks per-trade fee fields only. Net-return deduction is not checked.
implementation: Second Strike custom record; not a native Switch Rule or Decision.
